## Loan 2768-INO: Urban Sanitation and Rural Infrastructure Support to the PNPM Mandiri Project - Amendment to the Loan Agreement

1. This refers to the Ordinary Operations Loan Agreement ("Loan Agreement"), dated 30 September 2011, between the Republic of Indonesia ("Borrower") and the Asian Development Bank ("ADB") for the Urban Sanitation and Rural Infrastructure Support to the PNPM Mandiri Project ("Project").
2. It is noted that the Borrower has requested reallocation of loan proceeds to finance additional community development grants and consulting services under the Project. This will require amendment to the Allocation and Withdrawal of the Loan Proceeds Table ("Allocation Table"), which is an attachment to Schedule 3 of the Loan Agreement. Therefore, please find the attached revised Allocation Table, which should replace the earlier Allocation Table in the Loan Agreement.
3. Please indicate the agreement of the Borrower to the amendment described above by countersigning two (2) original counterparts of this letter in the space indicated below. One (1) signed original counterpart should be returned to ADB, and the other signed counterpart should be retained by the Borrower for its records. The amendments shall take effect from the date of receipt by ADB of the countersigned original of this letter.
4. Please be advised that according to ADB's Public Communications Policy ("PCP") on disclosure and exchange of information, the amendment to the Loan Agreements will automatically be publicly disclosed within two (2) weeks after its effectiveness, unless ADB is advised by return mail that the amendment contain any information or data of sensitive or confidential nature falling under the PCP exceptions.
